tagline.en: The Eastside bypass of Seattle, and its toll lanes
tagline.zh: 西雅图东区绕行线及其收费车道

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.en: I-5 at Tukwila, south of Seattle
start.zh: 西雅图以南塔克维拉，与 I-5 相接

end.en: I-5 at Lynnwood, north of Seattle
end.zh: 西雅图以北林伍德，与 I-5 相接

en: This is the other I-405 — Washington's, not California's. It leaves I-5 at Tukwila, runs up the east side of Lake Washington through Renton, Bellevue, Kirkland and Bothell, and rejoins I-5 at Lynnwood. The even hundreds digit is exactly right here: it is a bypass that returns to its parent, and it lets traffic avoid both downtown Seattle and the lake.

It is no longer a bypass in practice. Bellevue and Redmond grew into a second regional downtown, and the road that was meant to go round Seattle became the spine of the Eastside instead. WSDOT describes the Renton-to-Bellevue stretch as one of the worst commutes in the state. The department's answer has been tolling rather than more free lanes: express toll lanes already run from Bellevue north to Lynnwood, and the current project extends them south to link up with the SR 167 HOT lanes and produce a 40-mile tolled network.
zh: 这是另一条 I-405——华盛顿州的那条，不是加州的。它在塔克维拉离开 I-5，沿华盛顿湖东岸北上，经伦顿、贝尔维尤、柯克兰与博塞尔，在林伍德重新汇入 I-5。偶数百位在这里完全贴切：它是一条绕行线并回到母线，让车流既避开西雅图市中心，也避开湖面。
但实际上它已不再是绕行线。贝尔维尤与雷德蒙德长成了区域的第二个市中心，这条本为绕开西雅图而修的路，反倒成了东区的脊梁。华盛顿州交通部称伦顿至贝尔维尤段是全州最糟的通勤路段之一。该部门的对策是收费而非增加免费车道：快速收费车道已从贝尔维尤通到北面的林伍德，当前工程把它们向南延伸，与 SR 167 的高乘载收费车道衔接，形成一个 40 英里的收费网络。

en: The Renton to Bellevue widening was funded in 2015 under the state's Connecting Washington package. WSDOT's own engineer's estimate for the design-build contract was $650 million to $700 million; the contract was awarded on 1 October 2019 to a Flatiron West and Lane Construction joint venture for $704,975,000, and construction started in autumn 2020. The work adds one lane in each direction and combines it with the existing HOV lane to make a two-lane express toll system between SR 167 in Renton and Northeast Sixth Street in Bellevue.

It has not gone well. The contractual completion date was the end of 2025; in November 2025 WSDOT said that date was no longer achievable and set a new target of summer 2027, an eighteen-month slip. The state has been in active litigation with its own design-build contractor since 2023, asking the court both to reject the contractor's claims for additional payment and to award the state compensation for late completion.
zh: 伦顿至贝尔维尤拓宽工程的资金于 2015 年由该州「联通华盛顿」一揽子计划落实。华盛顿州交通部对设计－建造合同的工程师估价为 6.5 亿至 7 亿美元；合同于 2019 年 10 月 1 日授予 Flatiron West 与 Lane Construction 的联合体，金额 704,975,000 美元，工程于 2020 年秋开工。该工程每向增建一条车道，并与既有的合乘车道合并，在伦顿的 SR 167 与贝尔维尤的东北六街之间形成双车道快速收费系统。
进展并不顺利。合同约定的完工期是 2025 年底；2025 年 11 月，华盛顿州交通部表示该日期已无法实现，并把目标改为 2027 年夏，工期后延十八个月。自 2023 年以来，该州一直与自己的设计－建造承包商处于诉讼状态，既请法院驳回承包商的追加付款诉求，也要求就延期完工向该州赔偿。

why.en: WSDOT describes the Renton–Bellevue section as one of the worst commutes in the state but publishes traffic and revenue forecasts for the corridor rather than a current daily volume, and the department said in 2025 that those forecasts were being revised for the new schedule.
why.zh: 华盛顿州交通部称伦顿－贝尔维尤段是全州最糟的通勤路段之一，但其公布的是该走廊的交通量与收入预测而非当前日交通量；该部门在 2025 年表示，这些预测正因工期变更而重新修订。
